question: Should the Wave 2+ modular dashboard roadmap remain bundled OpenClaw Control UI/Gateway work, and which child slices should move to plugin, skill, or ClawHub ownership instead?
rationale: The requested work crosses untrusted widget sandboxing, persistent state, gateway RPCs, plugin SDK/API surface, install/import trust, and multi-operator visibility boundaries, so cleanup automation cannot safely choose the product boundary.

options.title: Keep Bundled Roadmap
options.body: Keep this tracker open and review the child issues and PRs in sequence with explicit security, storage, upgrade, and plugin-boundary decisions.

options.title: Move Optional Slices Outward
options.body: Keep only generic core/API seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widget packs, skills, registries, or tab-app bundles to ship through plugin or ClawHub paths.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Wave 2
options.body: Pause or close the roadmap if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboard expansion is not current product work.

recommendation.title: Keep Bundled Roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this tracker open and review the child issues and PRs in sequence with explicit security, storage, upgrade, and plugin-boundary decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this tracker and the live dashboard PR stack, so they are the best current source for narrowing the intended roadmap before maintainer approval.
